## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use arms to grab the light brown wooden roller.

Task description: The target is the light-brown wooden roller lying diagonally at the front of the table; both arms must grasp it and lift it off the table.

Success criteria: The rolling pin has been picked up and lifted to a suspended position with clear height above the tabletop, while both grippers remain closed; gripping it on the table or lifting it only slightly does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider having both arms grip sections of the shaft inward from each end, choosing areas wide enough for the full pads to reduce slipping from the tips.
- Open and close across the rod, opening only slightly wider than the grasp section. When approaching from above, confirm the fingers straddle it before closing to avoid one finger pushing and rolling it.
- Coordinate both arms during lifting and maintain the relative spacing of grasp points to reduce slipping from pulling against each other or twisting. Restore reliable roller support before regrasping if needed.
